_meta.source: Pensieve sample goals (anonymized fixture for tests + first-run demo)
_meta.house_mapping_rationale: Gryffindor=Goal1 (frontline regulator courage); Hufflepuff=Goal2 (sustained year-over-year dedication); Slytherin=Goal3 (strategic long-game foundation); Ravenclaw=Goal4 (innovation + intellect)
_meta.note: Replace via the Set Goals modal in the dashboard (upload your own Connect PDF) or by editing this file directly. Schema: see pensieve/enrichment/connect_goals.py.

goals.name: DORA Deep Dive Compliance
goals.summary: Lead the compliance program team on DORA through the deep dive examination phase. Partner with cloud product trust teams to deliver accurate JET responses on schedule. Co-develop regulatory readiness playbook.
success_criteria: All deep dive JET responses delivered on schedule with no compliance gaps
Co-author documented regulatory readiness playbook with cloud product trust
Structured, timely leadership updates on progress, risks, blockers
goals.impact_statement: Validated cross-org playbook accelerates NIS2 and UK CTP readiness. Integrated with Argus, becomes the operational foundation for how the compliance team responds to regulators at scale.

goals.name: UK CTP Year 1 Complete + Year 2 Launch
goals.summary: Deliver Year 1 UK CTP obligations following designation. Submit Self-Assessment within 3-month post-designation window. Initiate Year 2 roadmap for scenario testing and mapping exercises across systemic third-party services.
success_criteria: Validated Year 1 Self-Assessment submitted to regulators on time post-designation
Initial dependency mapping complete within 12 months of designation
Year 2 readiness roadmap: scenario testing, incident mgmt playbook, partner engagement model
Maintain weekly leadership update cadence (e.g. Friday update to manager that feeds their Monday leadership sync)
goals.impact_statement: Year 1 submission establishes regulatory credibility with BoE, PRA, FCA. Year 2 roadmap positions the team to lead scenario testing as a strategic program, not a reactive exercise.

goals.name: NIS2 Readiness Foundation
goals.summary: Build NIS2 foundational posture during H1 while Ireland transposition pending. Lead scoping + gap analysis. Apply communication-first model day one. Identify core team partners across engineering, legal, compliance.
success_criteria: NIS2 scope and gap assessment documenting anticipated obligations + current coverage
Communication-first model applied day one (leadership visibility plan alongside delivery plan)
Core team partners identified and engagement begun
goals.impact_statement: Builds NIS2 foundation now to reduce ramp time. Reusing DORA + UK CTP playbook multiplies prior investment. Demonstrates CISO GRC is scalable regulatory program function, not one-off engagements.

goals.name: AI Strategy, Innovation, and Transformation Program for CISO GRC
goals.summary: Design + operationalize structured AI transformation program for CISO GRC. Layered architecture across four capability areas (day-to-day automation, productivity multipliers, onboarding/knowledge, executive dashboards). Scale Argus from MVP to wider-used regulatory compliance platform.
success_criteria: Program launched with documented governance: idea intake, triage, piloting, adoption
Argus demos with cloud product leadership completed; next-phase investment secured
At least one production capability across each of the four focus areas
Argus dashboarding deployed for leadership near real-time program visibility
goals.impact_statement: Establishes CISO GRC as center of excellence for AI-driven regulatory compliance. Reduces manual toil, accelerates onboarding, closes leadership visibility gap. Capabilities scale across future regulatory obligations.

behaviors.trust_intentionally: Approachable, direct, action-oriented with partners across product, engineering, risk management, and legal. Invest in relationships. Focus energy on shared outcomes over org friction.
behaviors.solve_at_scale: Build solutions that serve more than the immediate problem. Push for consolidated tooling (ADO, Power BI) over siloed workflows. Bias toward durable technical solutions.
